Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

Indian Standard 
SPECIFICATION FOR TROLLEY, MEDICINE 



1. Scope — Dimensions and other requirements for medicine trolley. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig» 1. 

3. Material 

3.1 Framework — As given in 2,1 of IS : 4033-1968 * General requirements for hospital furniture \ 

3.2 Shelves — Any one of the materials specified in 2.2 (a) to 2,2 (c) of IS ; 4033-1968. 

3.3 Railings —UWd steel strips conforming to IS : 4030-1973 'Specification for cold rolled carbon 
steel strip for general engineering purposes (first revision) ' or IS ; 1029-1970 'Specification for 
hot rolled steel strips ( baling ) ( first revision ) \ 

3.4 Domed Caps — Mild steel, aluminium or PVC. 

3.5 Bow/s -Stainless steel conforming to Designation 04Cr18Ni10 or 07Cr18Ni9 of IS: 6911-1972 
* Specification for stainless steel plate, sheet and strip'. The wash bowls shall conform to 

IS: 3994-1967 'Specification for bowls, wash '. 

4. Manufacture and Workmanship 

4.1 The trolley shall have a welded framework of continuous lengths of mild steel tube as shown In 
Fig. 1. 

4.2 The shelves and the railings shall be welded to the upright members. 

4.3 The overall construction shall be sound and sturdy, 

4.4 The upper ends of the upright members shall be fitted with domed caps. 

4.5 The troliey shall be fitted with castors conforming to Designation HN 50 x 20 X 6 PG of 
IS : 4034-1968 * Specification for castors for hospital equipment '. 

4.5.1 The wheels of the castors shall have anti-static rubber tread or alternatively the construction 
of the trolley shall be such as to ensure transmission of static charge to the earth. 

4.6 The trolley shall be free from cracks, sharp edges and burrs. 

4.7 The trolley shall be provided with two stainless steel bowls which shall rest on rings hinged to 
the upright members as. shown in Fig. 1 

4.8 The trolley shall also conform to the requirements laid down in 4 of IS : 4033-1968, 

5. Finish The troliey shall be finished in accordance with 5 of IS : 4033-1968. In painting the 
enamels for the undercoating and finishing coat shall conform to*IS : 2932-1964 ' Specification for 
enamel, synthetic, exterior, Type 1, (a) undercoating, (b) finishing, colour as required '. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Adhesion Test — As prescribed in 6.1.1 of IS : 4033-1968. 

6.2 Performance Test— As prescribed in 6.1.2 of 15:4033-1968. However, only the performance 
without any load on the trolley shall be determined. 

7. Marking — As given in 7.1 of IS : 4033-1968. 

7.1 Certification Marking — DeXaWs available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer. 
•Since revised. 



Adopted 15 November 1973
